token.label: Personal Access Token
token.description:
To obtain your personal token, follow these steps:
1. Log in to your Airtable account.
2. Visit https://airtable.com/create/tokens/ to create one
3. Click on "+ Add a base" and select the base you want to use or all bases. To create new bases, also add the workspace under "+ Add a workspace".
4. Click on "+ Add a scope" and select "data.records:read", "data.records:write", "data.recordComments:read", "data.recordComments:write", "schema.bases:read" and "schema.bases:write" for full functionality.
5. Click on "Create token" and copy the token.

get_base_schema_ai.afterResponse: const tables = response.tables.map((table) => ({id: table.id, name: table.name, description: table.description, primaryFieldId: table.primaryFieldId, fields: table.fields.map((field) => ({id: field.id, name: field.name, type: field.type, description: field.description}))})); return {tables, count: tables.length};

filename.label: File Name

upsert_records.label: Upsert Records (Agent)
upsert_records.description: Create or update up to 10 records in one batch call.

base_id.label: Base ID
base_id.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).

table_id_or_name.label: Table ID or Name
table_id_or_name.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).

records.label: Records
records.description: A JSON array of up to 10 records, each shaped {"fields": {"Name": "Acme", "Status": "Active"}}. To update an existing record without merge keys, include its id: {"id": "recXXXX", "fields": {...}}. Use Get Base Schema (Agent) for field names.

fields_to_merge_on.label: Fields To Merge On
fields_to_merge_on.description: Optional list of field names used as the match key for upsert, e.g. ["Email"]. When set, records matching on these fields are updated, others created. Leave empty for a plain batch update by id.

typecast.label: Typecast
typecast.description: When true (default), Airtable coerces string values to the field type and auto-creates select options. Set false for strict typing.

upsert_records.beforeRequest: const body = request.body; const records = body.records; if (!Array.isArray(records) || records.length === 0) throw new Error('Records must be a non-empty JSON array.'); if (records.length > 10) throw new Error('Airtable accepts at most 10 records per upsert call; received ' + records.length + '. Split into batches of 10.'); if (body.typecast === undefined) body.typecast = true; if (!(body.performUpsert.fieldsToMergeOn || []).length) delete body.performUpsert; return request;
upsert_records.afterResponse: return {records: response.records, count: response.records.length, createdRecords: response.createdRecords ?? [], updatedRecords: response.updatedRecords ?? []};

delete_records_batch.label: Delete Records Batch (Agent)
delete_records_batch.description: Delete up to 10 records by ID in one call.

base_id.label: Base ID
base_id.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).

table_id_or_name.label: Table ID or Name
table_id_or_name.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).

record_ids.label: Record IDs
record_ids.description: A list of up to 10 record IDs to delete, e.g. ["recAAA", "recBBB"]. Resolve IDs with Search Records (Agent) or List Records (Agent).

delete_records_batch.beforeRequest: const ids = JSON.parse(inputs.record_ids); if (!Array.isArray(ids) || ids.length === 0) throw new Error('Record IDs must be a non-empty list.'); if (ids.length > 10) throw new Error('Airtable deletes at most 10 records per call; received ' + ids.length + '. Split into batches of 10.'); ids.forEach((id, index) => { request.query['records[' + index + ']'] = id; }); return request;

create_table_ai.label: Create Table (Agent)

base_id.label: Base ID
base_id.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).

name.label: Table Name
name.description: The name for the new table.

description.label: Description
description.description: Optional description for the new table.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: A JSON array of field definitions; the first entry becomes the primary field. Each entry is {"name": "...", "type": "singleLineText", "description"?: "..."}. Select fields need {"type": "singleSelect", "options": {"choices": [{"name": "Todo"}]}}.

workspace_id.label: Workspace ID
workspace_id.description: The workspace ID (e.g. "wspXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") to create the base in. Airtable has no list-workspaces API; get it from a base's metadata or the Airtable UI URL.

name.label: Base Name
name.description: The name for the new base.

tables.label: Tables
tables.description: A JSON array of tables for the new base. Each table is {"name": "...", "fields": [{"name": "Name", "type": "singleLineText"}, ...]}. The first field of each table becomes its primary field.

update_table.label: Update Table (Agent)

base_id.label: Base ID
base_id.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).

table_id_or_name.label: Table ID or Name
table_id_or_name.description: The table ID (e.g. "tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX") or its exact name. Resolve it with Get Base Schema (Agent).

name.description: Optional new name for the table.

description.label: New Description
description.description: Optional new description for the table.

update_table.beforeRequest: if (!inputs.name && !inputs.description) throw new Error('Supply at least one of New Name or New Description.'); return request;

create_field.label: Create Field (Agent)
create_field.description: Add a new field (column) to a table.

base_id.label: Base ID
base_id.description: The Airtable base ID (e.g. "appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"). Resolve it with List Bases (Agent).

table_id_or_name.label: Table ID or Name

name.label: Field Name

options.label: Options

update_field.label: Update Field (Agent)

description.label: New Description

update_field.beforeRequest: if (!inputs.name && !inputs.description) throw new Error('Supply at least one of New Name or New Description.'); return request;

table_id_or_name.label: Table ID or Name
